pseudocode_to_real_api_adaptations: BaseValueTable has no CEASEFIRE/PEACE_TREATY in the 'agreements' JSON block — they are read at root level via o.optInt('agreements_ceasefire',...). Fields are NON_AGGRESSION_PACT (not NAP), ALLIANCE, TRADE_PACT, CEASEFIRE, PEACE_TREATY. Used BaseValueTable.NON_AGGRESSION_PACT where pseudocode said BaseValueTable.NAP.
BaseValueTable.BLUEPRINT_MULT is an int (10), STAR_CHART is an int (750). Product is int arithmetic (7500), cast to float fine for ItemValuator.getKnowledgeValue return.

BaseValueTable.INTEL default is 500, not 2000 (was INTEL_BASE=2000 in old code). NegotiableItemCatalog.estimatedUnitValue now returns 500 for ID_INTEL_BASIC and 2500 for ID_INTEL_DEEP, matching ItemValuator.
DealPackage.getLeaderBalance uses getOffers()/getRequests() (not getProposerOffers()/getReceiverOffers()) — those are on DealProposal, not DealPackage.
BalanceCalculator.evaluate takes DealProposal, not DealPackage. AutoBalanceSolver already used DealProposal — pseudocode was correct for that file; no API change needed there.

AutoBalanceSolver had no direct 'new AutoNegotiator(new DealEvaluator())' pattern — it takes an evaluator from outside. The two AutoNegotiator call sites (AIProposalManager:99, NegotiationPanel:628) already pass the evaluator through, so they automatically benefit from the leader-aware evaluator once the caller is updated.
NegotiationPanel constructor assigned 'this.evaluator' (line 112) BEFORE 'this.leader' (line 123). Reordered: leader is now assigned first so it can be passed to the DealEvaluator constructor.
DeclarationType.RIVALRY exists — DENOUNCE || RIVALRY → DENOUNCEMENT_DECLARATION mapping implemented as specified.
Valuator.scarcityMod(String leaderFactionId, String itemId) signature confirmed correct — used as-is in 16i.
LeaderProfile(factionId, Personality) constructor confirmed — synthetic profiles in 16i use it directly.

Nex4xDebugCommand.smokeTest() calls BalanceCalculator.evaluate(deal, heg, 500) — BalanceCalculator is deprecated but NOT deleted, so smokeTest() compiles unchanged. This was the least-churn approach per PRD instructions.
